item.title: How switching to MemSQL made my day
item.description: I’m a programmer and these days using Python for a data consolidation task on millions of rows of data. My code reads all the data from a sqlite database, creates the required output table filled with zeros and then checks the input row by row and add to the counts on the required cells of the output table. In the reality I work with SMSs but assume I’m working with fruits to prevent a NDA complain filled by my boss against me.
